description: GrowPanel is a SaaS subscription-analytics platform. This connector lets ChatGPT answer real questions about your subscription business in plain language: MRR, churn (logo and MRR), retention (NRR/GRR), cohorts, MRR movements, cashflow, leads and trials, customer concentration, plans, and individual customers. Ask things like "What was my MRR churn by month this year?", "Show retention for customers who signed up in Q1", "Which plans are growing?", or "List my top customers by MRR". All figures come straight from your GrowPanel account in its base currency, and access is scoped to the signed-in user and their GrowPanel role (read-only users cannot make changes).

defaultPrompt: What was my MRR churn by month this year — both logo and MRR churn?
How is my MRR trending in this year, split into new, expansion and churn?
Who are my top 10 customers by MRR right now?
